prose.text: Building shift leads need a daily report showing short picks per picker so they can target retraining and reduce errors.
Sam manually builds a weekly Excel report from WMS exports; WMS dashboard only shows totals, not per picker.
Automate a daily report per picker, ready by 6am, using WMS pick confirmation data and clear short-pick rules.
Over picks and customer/pricing data are not included; only short picks per picker per shift per day.
If the report disagrees with WMS two weeks in a row, Sam will revert to the manual spreadsheet.

acceptance.given: WMS pick confirmation data is available and the report is generated by 6am each day
acceptance.when: Shift leads receive a per picker, per shift, per day short-pick report with wrong-location scans included
acceptance.then: They can use it to select pickers for retraining each Tuesday

acceptance.given: The report disagrees with WMS pick confirmation numbers for two consecutive weeks
acceptance.when: Sam checks the numbers against WMS
acceptance.then: He switches off the new report and returns to the manual spreadsheet

guardrails.text: If the report disagrees with WMS two weeks in a row, switch it off and revert to manual spreadsheet.

open_questions.question: Should wrong-location scans always count as short picks, or are there exceptions?

open_questions.question: Should the report be per picker per shift per day, or weekly?

reflect_back_text: You want a daily short-pick report per picker, built from WMS confirmations, ready by 6am so shift leads can target retraining. Today you do this manually in Excel, but it takes four hours and only gives weekly results. If the new report disagrees with WMS for two weeks, you'll switch it off and go back to your spreadsheet.
